title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode4 Responsibility and Resolve

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Can you come to practice today? We were thinking about trying out a new song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I have to work again today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll keep practicing and make sure that we'll be ready for when you can make it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go. We're gonna be late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika's been trying so hard lately too, and gotten so much better...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone else too. They put up with everything I made them do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I made Saki cry too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I let her finish, she might've actually said that she wants to go pro too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But thoughts alone won't be enough. She'll absolutely end up regretting that decision...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't want her to feel that way ever again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There doesn't seem to be anything special going on with today's show so...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Yes, my name is Mio. I'm the bassist for STANDOUT...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'd like to apologize about the other day. I feel terrible about making you play in my place like that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was a little startled, but at least everything ended up going smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More to the point, is there something going on between you and Iori...?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: After it became clear that we'd be making our big debut, I became scared and started avoiding everyone...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori said that after we turn pro, we'll have to invest much more time and really commit to our music...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: For the longest time, I just wanted to have fun while playing in a band...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: We all came up with songs together, played in shows and really seemed to be enjoying it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She's almost the same as Ichika.
Having fun with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori told me that having fun or just liking music won't be enough when we go pro.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: She said that we'd have to put our music and fans first above anything else. She said that we'd be responsible for how they feel.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I just couldn't understand what she meant by that. Is there something wrong with just playing whatever music we like...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This responsibility she's talking about may be about playing your best whenever you're on stage. At least, that's what I think...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if you don't feel well or become sick, your audience will be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's also the staff that help make your shows happen. You'd be putting all their hard work to waste as well.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I... I didn't realize I was being so selfish...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I was so scared that everything would change. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to play music with Iori and everyone else like we have been...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She really is the same. This is probably what'll end up happening to everyone else too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Going from playing in a band for fun to playing professionally would be too big a leap of faith for most people...)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I still want to be in a band with them. I want to keep walking the same path as Iori...!

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I kept running away and ended up disappointing Iori but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to go pro and get better.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to play music that can really move people, like that band can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I do really like being in a band with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I see a part of me within her too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The part that still wants to be in a band with my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to give this back to you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll need these if you want to keep playing for STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I... I'm so sorry. After she spent so much time recruiting you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Please, don't worry about that.
It was never mine to keep anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do agree with Iori about rethinking what you want to do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Right. About our responsibility as professionals...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. As long as you're willing to invest a little more time into your music, I think you'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you don't think you can keep up with Iori or feel like you'll end up disappointing her even further, you may want to find something else to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you came this far and even got a record deal. That mean's you're at least that good.
